verdicts.reason: Both use the same broken layout. The body copy is much larger than the CTA, so the 'Reserve a Case' button is a tiny, unreadable pill crammed into the right column. The 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow and the legal text are illegible specks, and the right column of fine print is a cramped clump next to the large body text. B's CTA label is slightly more legible, but its orange divider sits almost on top of 'Evenings'. A's eyebrow and rule are reduced to an indistinct dash cluster above the button. Neither is shippable.
